sec.softDesc: A disabled control that stays focusable and shows its reason. In a form, as a link and as a trigger it does nothing.
sec.mixedDesc: md, sm and toolbar controls side by side, in the default density and in a compact area: compact makes rows dense and never makes a control small.
sec.scopeDesc: A 32 scope and its inner boundary: a default toolbar or a default scope inside it is default at any depth.
sec.defaultDesc: One specimen per cell of the control spec (kit/controlSpec.ts): each size and state a control has. The browser matrix measures each one in light and dark, with a mouse and on a touch screen, against its target.
sec.compactDesc: The same specimens inside a compact area. Density never changes a control's height: compact tightens rows only, so every target here equals the default one.
sec.tabsRow: Tabs on a row of toolbar controls
sec.tabsRowDesc: toolbarRow: the tabs stand on the line, the controls before and after them sit 8 px above it, the open tab’s label on their line.
